The '''Spell of Interpretation''' was a technique used by the [[Witches of Dathomir]] that allowed the caster to translate a [[Language/Legends|language]] and speak it in kind.

Any language, including [[Binary/Legends|droidspeak]], could be understood. This knowledge of a language, however, was temporary and artificial, as it only lasted as long as the spell was kept active.
